title: Method and apparatus for mounting electrical components that employs a compensation element

features.item: A housing with a grip portion designed as a hollow body for gripping
features.note: The reference describes a mounting apparatus with a mounting head and retaining device, but does not mention a housing with a hollow grip portion.

features.item: An electrically operated vacuum generating device in the housing
features.note: The reference describes a component mounting apparatus but does not mention an electrically operated vacuum generating device.

features.item: Exhaust air from the vacuum generating device guided through the hollow grip portion to an air outlet
features.note: The reference does not mention a vacuum generating device, exhaust air, or a hollow grip portion.

features.item: A sound-damping device arranged in the grip portion
features.note: The reference does not mention a grip portion or a sound-damping device.

features.item: A suction plate with carrier plate and seal extending around the carrier plate
features.note: The reference describes a retaining device for an electrical component, but not a suction plate with a carrier plate and seal.

features.item: A grip unit with hollow grip portion, electrically operated vacuum generator, exhaust air routed through grip to outlet, and sound-damping in grip
features.note: The reference does not describe a grip unit with these specific components and functionalities.

features.item: Grip unit and suction plate combined in a vacuum handling apparatus
features.note: The reference describes a component mounting apparatus, not a vacuum handling apparatus with a grip unit and suction plate.

features.item: Grip portion at least partially lined with sound-damping material
features.note: The reference does not mention a grip portion or sound-damping material.

features.item: Vacuum generating device arranged completely in a first housing portion
features.note: The reference does not mention a vacuum generating device or a first housing portion.

features.item: Sound-reducing device in the first housing portion or first housing portion lined with sound-reducing material
features.note: The reference does not mention a sound-reducing device or a first housing portion.

features.item: Grip portion elongated between first and second housing portions with air outlet on second housing portion
features.note: The reference does not describe a grip portion or multiple housing portions with an air outlet.

features.item: Air collection screw upstream of grip portion in first housing portion for collecting exhaust air
features.note: The reference does not mention an air collection screw, grip portion, or exhaust air.

features.item: Bent or curved air baffles downstream of grip portion directing exhaust air to air outlet
features.note: The reference does not mention air baffles, a grip portion, or exhaust air.

features.item: Battery coupling point on second housing portion with air baffles directing exhaust air away from battery coupling point
features.note: The reference does not mention a battery coupling point, housing portions, air baffles, or exhaust air.

features.item: Grip unit and suction plate releasably connected via a coupling device
features.note: The reference does not describe a grip unit or suction plate, nor a releasable connection between them.

features.item: Grip unit with suction opening fluidically connected to suction chamber delimited by suction plate
features.note: The reference does not describe a grip unit, suction opening, suction chamber, or suction plate.

claims.note: The reference describes an apparatus for mounting electrical components, not a grip unit for a vacuum hand-operated laying device.
The reference describes a mounting apparatus with a mounting head and retaining device, not a housing with a grip portion and an electrically operated vacuum generating device.
The reference does not describe any part of its apparatus as a hollow body.
The reference does not mention exhaust air, vacuum generating devices, or air outlets.
This reference discusses a damping member for a spring in an electrical component mounting apparatus, not a sound-damping device in a grip portion.
This reference does not mention a grip portion lined with sound-damping material.
This reference does not describe a vacuum generating device or its arrangement within a housing portion.
This reference does not mention a sound-reducing device or material in a housing portion.
This reference describes an apparatus for mounting electrical components, not a grip unit with an elongated grip portion or air outlets on a second housing portion.
This reference describes an apparatus for mounting electrical components, not a grip unit with an air collection device or an air collection screw.
This reference describes an apparatus for mounting electrical components, not a grip unit with air baffles for guiding exhaust air.
This reference describes an apparatus for mounting electrical components, not a grip unit with a battery coupling point or air baffles for directing exhaust air.
The reference does not mention air baffles, exhaust air, or battery coupling points.
The reference describes an apparatus for mounting electrical components, not a vacuum handling apparatus.
The reference does not describe a suction plate, carrier plate, or a seal fastened to a carrier plate.
The reference does not describe a grip unit.

claims.quote: An apparatus according to claim 4 wherein said damping member comprises a coupling member.
claims.note: The reference discloses a coupling member as part of a damping member, but not specifically that a grip unit and suction plate are releasably connected via a coupling device.
The reference does not disclose a grip unit with a suction opening fluidically connected to a suction chamber to generate a vacuum for lifting an object.

overall.why: The reference describes an apparatus and method for mounting electrical components using a compensating element with a spring and damping member, which is a different technical area from the subject invention's focus on a vacuum handling apparatus with a specific housing, grip, and air management sy
